messages.subject: Make for Windows
parts:
I finally fixed the makefile under Windows so that we can create executables without having to specify .exe at the end.

That means we can either type:
> make bin/stanc
or
> make bin/stanc.exe



What does this mean? We can simplify our instructions because the Windows targets are now identical to linux and Mac targets. Running the targets still require a backslash, but we can't do anything about that.

The fix was to add a target in the make/os_win makefile with a new target
% : %.exe


I don't know why I didn't think of adding that target before in a place that only gets activated under Windows.


Daniel
